source: Hopper H100 and Blackwell B200 both support configurable shared-memory carveouts within a 256 KB unified L1/texture/shared resource, with up to 228 KB of shared-memory capacity per ZXNAME0000XZ and up to 227 KB addressable by one opted-in block on those specific devices.[5][6]
zh: Hopper H100 和 Blackwell B200 均支持 256 KB 统一 L1/纹理/共享资源内的可配置共享内存分割，每个 ZXNAME0000XZ 具有高达 228 KB 的共享内存容量，并且由这些特定设备上的一个选择加入的块可寻址高达 227 KB。[5][6]
